entries.notes: The pinned source contains 19 executable it(...) cases although the generated declaration counter reports 20. All 19 are translated, plus one Rust-only authorization target for WF-RUST-017. Coverage preserves basic text, function/provider/mixed/sequential/error-recovery/multimodal tools, constructor and method callback ordering, captured finish data, string instructions, timeout, prepareStep precedence and numbering, and every documented experimental gap. The TypeScript tool-approval case is retained explicitly as evidence that needsApproval currently produces both a call and result, while the separate Rust target requires one pending riskyTool call, zero results, and no execution before approval. Final GREEN must route the compatibility characterization through a TypeScript oracle and make the production Rust path satisfy the secure target; implementing the unsafe legacy result in the Rust agent loop is prohibited.
